- Guest target: 28–32 (Redwood + Helix execs + key engineers/customers)
- Arrival: guest arrivals begin 18:00, plated dinner seating 19:00, remarks 19:15–19:30
- Transportation: two 12-seat shuttles from Hotel Bristow at 18:15 and 18:30 (proposed)
- AV: one lav + podium mic for brief remarks; projector for one deck (we'll bring HDMI adapter)
- Billing: invoice to Helix PO or Redwood to charge and invoice Helix — please confirm preferred flow

Action items for you:
1) Confirm final guest list and dietary restrictions (use attached menu_dietary_grid.pdf OR the RSVP sheet link below)
2) Confirm whether you want a head table for your execs (we can reserve 6 seats)
3) Confirm shuttle pickup address: Hotel Bristow, 120 Townsend St

Attachments: draft menu + dietary grid. RSVP sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB2cDiningRSVP

I'll loop Laura (events) to lock vendor and seating once we have headcount. Marissa, Vivek — flagging for billing/discount approvals.
